mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: The top six held yesterday's exact order: Steal An Egg (97 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (13 days), 99 Nights in the Forest, Murder Mystery 2 and RIVALS.

Young simulators led the climbers: Throw Food For Animals +23 at 42 days, Drive a Cart Downhill! +20 at 26 days, My Small Business +18 at 13 days and My Bus +15; BloxStrike (546 days) rose 12 with a zombies update.
The Halloween lift is fading for old horror: The Mimic fell 28 a day after entering, and Home Alone: Anomalies left the chart.
Six games entered, including Banana Eats (2,534 days, Hollow event), Night Rider (19 days) and Steal A Pet And Ride It!; seven left, among them Dubai RP and Paint to Get Rich.
Games aged 123 to 365 days sit at the 31st median percentile against the 56th for multi-year evergreens and the 47th for 15-42-day games, the mid-life trough again (H-mp-009 at 48%).
patterns: Pricing tends to go with staying power: a median product price above 400 R$ splits days on the chart at r=+0.47, and median passes above 79 R$ at r=+0.41 (H-mp-011, H-mp-016 at 65%).
Games left more than 20 days without an update stay fewer days (r=-0.59), and recent updates now tend to go with higher positions too (H-mp-006 up from 43% to 58%).
More original concepts consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-013 at 77%) and solo loops consistently sit lower (H-mp-003 at 73%).

Simulation-job (74th percentile), party-minigame (71st) and steal-defend-base (69th) loops lead, while wave-survival co-op (32nd), collect-upgrade-rebirth (31st) and '+1' incrementals (34th) trail; 'Egg' titles go with higher positions (r=+0.42).
Big evergreens consistently convert fewer visits into favorites (H-mp-010 at 78%), so a high favorite rate here marks a young game, not a durable one.

outliers.name: DONT SPLASH
outliers.note: Still #3 at 13 days, far ahead of the age curve; its single noise rule makes short, shareable rounds (H-x-019).

outliers.name: Cook the Chicken (by slapping it)
outliers.note: Entered at 24 days with no passes and five products, at the bottom of the chart: a one-joke curiosity hook that reaches Most Popular but sits low.

outliers.name: The Mimic
outliers.note: A 2,114-day horror game that entered on its Halloween update and fell 28 places the next day, showing how short a seasonal lift can be for an old game.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Donation hubs again top efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), followed by Elemental Dungeons, Build and Burn (25 days) and Dinosaur Simulator (4,245 days).
The least efficient games are this week's breakouts: Realistic Ragdoll Engine (18 days), DONT SPLASH, My Small Business and Throw Food For Animals, all with high CCU and revenue still catching up.
Throw Food For Animals (+128), Ro-BassFishing (+83), Anime Expeditions (+77) and Realistic Ragdoll Engine (+75) climbed most; Lanterns (-82), Anime Breaker and Save The Egg (-50 each) fell most.
Fifteen games entered (Survive the Killer, Criminal Simulator, Own a Catboy Café, Ryujin, Hike For Eggs among them) and fifteen left.
Efficiency rises steadily with age, from the 1st median percentile at 0-14 days to the 30th at 15-42 days and the 60th past a year (H-te-001 at 82%).
patterns: Pricing high consistently pays: median products above 79 R$ (H-te-005), a pass above 999 R$ (H-te-006) and median passes above 399 R$ (H-te-025) all sit at 85%.

RPGs (r=+0.47), roleplay hubs (r=+0.32) and deeper, more complex builds (rho=+0.25) consistently earn more per player, while Survival (r=-0.38), Simulation (r=-0.25) and solo loops (r=-0.28) consistently earn less.

Title keywords split sharply: 'Egg' (r=-0.68), 'Animal' (-0.47) and 'Steal' (-0.45) go with weak efficiency, 'Defense' (+0.30) and 'Life' (+0.28) with strong; a tower-defense loop test is proposed today.
Servers above about 40 players split efficiency at r=+0.39, consistent with H-te-007 (25+ players at 85%).
No new gameplay videos were labelled today, so the video evidence on durable earners (skins, paid roles, dense HUDs) is unchanged.

outliers.name: Build and Burn
outliers.note: At 25 days with one pass, it already ranks among the most efficient earners, against the six-week rule (H-te-001); a small, loyal racing audience is the likely reason.

outliers.name: Metro Life 🏡 City RP
outliers.note: A roleplay hub (normally strong) at #457 on Top Earning; its 254 products are mostly 19-29 R$ furniture and car decor, the opposite of the high-median pricing that works.

outliers.name: Throw Food For Animals
outliers.note: Climbed 128 places yet remains among the least efficient, a young breakout whose revenue is still catching up with its players (H-te-018).

tt.pillar: Early Momentum: rapid upward movement on Top Trending, among games 0–4 months old only.
tt.metric: daily position gain on Top Trending
observations: +1 Anime Eyes (16 days) leads momentum at +24, with Fart Together +20 (18 days), Scary Baboon Reimagined +20 (74 days), Teach Your Sister How To Drive! +15 and Durian Garden +14 (9 days).
Banana Eats fell 59 as the Hollow event wound down, and T-Rex vs 99 Players (-29), Flying Tesla Roadster (-23) and Airport Security (Anomaly) (-20) fell back.
Twenty games entered, including Raise The Biggest Family, WARDEN Sonaria Horror Escape, +1 Spider Arm and Say Cheese!; nineteen left, among them The Hollow, DOORS and Ride a Dino.
Games updated in the last day moved a median -4 against -2 for the rest, so update days alone are not lifting momentum.
Games 15-42 days old sit at the 59th median percentile against the 40th at 43-84 days and 32nd at 85-122 days, consistent with H-tt-001 (62%).
patterns: Smaller servers may help here: within the same age band, servers above 24 players go with lower positions (-0.40), the opposite of Top Earning; a tested hypothesis is proposed today.
Luck passes tend to go with lower positions (H-tt-039 at 67%, r=-0.46), while a collection index consistently goes with higher ones (H-tt-028 at 72%).

New signals today: cosmetic passes (r=+0.43), survival framing (+0.35) and group publishers (+0.43) go with stronger results, and text-ad thumbnails with weaker momentum (-0.43); all four are proposed as tests.
Solo loops climbed faster today (r=+0.33 within age), against H-tt-008 (34%), which keeps weakening.
Simulation-job (88th), sandbox-physics (74th) and wave-survival co-op (72nd) loops lead, while story adventures (18th), roleplay (23rd) and collect-upgrade-rebirth (27th) trail.

outliers.name: [🌍UPD] +1 Anime Eyes

uc.pillar: Breakout Popularity: higher positions within Up-and-Coming.
observations: Raise The Biggest Family (17 days, +45) now leads, ahead of +1 Spider Arm (11 days, +61), DONT SPLASH, +1 Anime Eyes, Say Cheese! (11 days, +34) and My Small Business.
TROLL Jail Hug Tower (+47) and Ragdoll Playground (+40) also rose fast; T-Rex vs 99 Players (-33), A Long Flight (-32), Build Whatever! (-31, 53% likes) and 7 Days as a Pet (-26) fell.
Fourteen games entered, including the Malay horror MALAM SAMA OPAH (10 days), Facecard: Makeup Showdown (Junior), Sell a Million Sushi and Make Viral Candy!; thirteen left.
The newest games lead: 0-14 days at the 66th median percentile, 15-42 days at the 49th and 43-84 days at the 33rd.
patterns: Survival framing consistently goes with higher positions (H-uc-047 at 74%, within-age +0.45), and recent updates now do too (H-uc-012 up to 70%).
Luck consistently hurts breakout: luck passes (H-uc-018 at 70%) and, proposed today, RNG or luck framing in general (r=-0.43).
Caps-heavy titles rank lower within age bands (-0.46), mirroring H-mp-002; proposed as a test today.
Gameplay thumbnails (H-uc-040 at 72%) and original concepts (H-uc-039 at 74%) consistently rank higher, while selling skips now tends to go with lower positions (H-uc-045 up from 38% to 69%).
Racing and driving (80th), sandbox physics (76th) and steal-defend-base (73rd) lead the loops; collect-upgrade-rebirth (20th), party minigames and roleplay (30th each) trail.

summary: Server size splits the charts: servers of 25 or more consistently earn more per player on Top Earning (H-te-007), while young games with servers of 24 or fewer hold higher Top Trending positions; a test is proposed today.

Luck splits reach from revenue: a roll or luck layer goes with better Top Earning efficiency (H-te-037 at 72%) but luck passes and framing rank lower on Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, the same reach-versus-revenue split as the steal/egg template (H-x-002).
Survival framing lifts Up-and-Coming (74%) and now Top Trending momentum, yet consistently earns less per player (H-te-021 at 85%).
The Halloween and Hollow lift is fading: The Mimic fell 28 on Most Popular, Banana Eats 59 on Top Trending, and The Hollow and Home Alone: Anomalies left their charts.
The ragdoll physics wave keeps spreading (Realistic Ragdoll Engine +75 on Top Earning, Ragdoll Playground +40 on Up-and-Coming and onto Top Trending); H-x-021 rises to 60%.
No gameplay videos were labelled today: the four queued long-running hits (Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG, Basketball: Zero) arrived without frames.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (148 entries, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (119, 2 days).
uc→te (87, 5 days), tt→te (84, 4 days), te→tt (75, 9 days) and uc→mp (75, 4 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
